parameter_constraints: 0<rho; 0<g<=1; kappa>=0; 0<=f<=1; common total observed reference rate r profiled
likelihood: reference and older Bernoulli outcomes share Gamma(k,k) effect within each well; common r profiled jointly
equivalence: parameters enter through a=rho*g*f and b=kappa*(1-g); a+b alone suffices only if every q=1
model_conflict: reference-fit conditional probability of all older zeros below alpha or f=0 joint-vs-reference-only profiled deviance above -2log(alpha); uncalibrated flag, never compatibility
coverage: none for this new observation model; inherited -2log(alpha) is a comparison convention only
engine_grid: change one of leave-out, age scenario or allocation from baseline; no joint coverage claim
randomness: none; deterministic profiling and source joins
resources: local mini, at most four workers; time/memory smoke before full grid
output_policy: new loop2 outputs only; frozen Loop1 input/code/result/receipt bytes unchanged
